item.title: Leicester’s National Space Centre to host To Boldly Game tabletop weekend
item.description: The National Space Centre in Leicester announces To Boldly Game, a weekend of roleplaying, board games, and miniature painting this January.

item.title: Rolemaster Unified core books get a staggered rollout on Foundry VTT
item.description: Iron Crown Enterprises has announced an imminent staggered release for Rolemaster Unified on Foundry VTT to ensure a stable digital experience.

item.title: Infinite Black hit by massive inventory theft; Nocturnus RPG postponed
item.description: David LaRocca addresses the community regarding a serious blow to Infinite Black that has forced the delay of the new Eclipse D20 horror game.

item.title: Routinely Itemised: RPG #344
item.description: Stay updated with this week's TTRPG news from Edinburgh. We cover the Infinite Black product controversy, Games Workshop's new AI ban for staff, and R. Talsorian Games' latest e-commerce investment. Plus, discover 2026's most anticipated roleplaying games as voted by EN World.

item.title: Gwar conquers the Pink Pony Club in viral Chappell Roan cover
item.description: Watch Gwar deliver a blistering metal cover of Chappell Roan’s Pink Pony Club for The A.V. Club’s record-breaking Undercover session.

item.title: Kraken Wargames joins Wayland Games in major tabletop merger
item.description: Wayland Games' parent company, the Wyld Group, has acquired German manufacturer Kraken Wargames, bringing their premium mats and hobby racks into the family.

item.title: A Digital Backup Plan: Why veteran Keepers should look at Chaosium’s new Humble bundle
item.description: Chaosium’s latest Humble Bundle isn't just for beginners. Grab digital copies of Nameless Horrors, Dead Light, and the Investigator Handbook to round out your 7th Edition library.

item.title: The Death of the Safe Bet: How community toppled the IP giants
item.description: Discover how independent creators dismantled the corporate monopoly on hype. Our 14-year data analysis reveals why community intimacy now outvalues global IP.

item.title: Audio EXP Podcast: #317 – Demon Ponies vs Computers
item.description: Explore why Games Workshop is banning AI and how Gwar conquered the Pink Pony Club in this episode of Audio EXP. We also look at the rise of indie roleplaying games.

item.title: Sticki Rolls targets broader audience with major Minecraft partnership
item.description: Over 600 Minecraft stickers are coming to your wrist. Sky Castle announces a new Sticki Rolls collection featuring iconic game elements for late 2026.
